files_reviewed: src/agents (other Patient* and Schedule* agents: same 26-line shape, not read line by line)
note: No model call anywhere. 'Agents' are Redis pub/sub state-machine steps for a dental clinic chat flow in Portuguese. No AI categories apply. The flow collects patient data and never creates an appointment.

labels.what: Final step says payment noted and the team will confirm, but no booking, payment or clinic system is called. The summary only goes back into the Redis stream
Says service registered. It only writes text to the Redis flow state; the same shape repeats in ScheduleDentistAgent lines 15-23 and the other Schedule agents
Patient name, birth date, CPF (national ID) and email are saved as plain JSON in Redis under flow:user:<phone> with no expiry and no encryption
The CPF is accepted after stripping non-digits with no length or checksum check. Other Patient agents also store raw replies
Any client that can publish to the chatbot_activation channel can start any agent for any phone number. Payload is parsed with no auth or schema check
waitForUserMessage trusts any entry with direction inbound in the user:<phone> stream; there is no sender check. Anyone with Redis access can write answers for a patient
Client secret compared with !== (not constant time) and secrets held in plain text in memory
Caller picks expiresInSeconds with no upper cap, so a client can mint a very long-lived token; jwt.sign sets no algorithm explicitly
Redis URL falls back to redis://localhost:6379 with no password
Demo agent names Ada, Turing, Hopper, Lovelace, Tesla and a 750 ms delay are hardcoded defaults
Sample agent identities created for a demo script, not a real registry
